regions.full_page: "Adam was 130 yrs. old when he begot Seth who was sent in place of Abel -- lived 800 years after that,930. Moabites Descendents of Lot and Ist daughter. Ammonites Descend- ents of Lot and younger daughter. Abimelech, King of Gerara, Fears God. Sarah - Abraham half sister and wife (Genesis XX) Explanation of Rebecca's "lie" - not a lie ( see Gen. chap. 25). However there does seem to be deception as seen in Chap. XXVII. St. Augustine says its a mystery. How about ... mental reserve .... after all they too were of fallen humanity. Galaad i.e. witness heap. - between Jacob & Laban ... and uncle - Father-in-law, Laban. Phanuel where Jacob wrestled with the Angel and received the name Israel. Jacob on his way to Hebron losses Rachel in delivery of Benjamin; buries her at Bethleham and with his twin Br. Esau buried Israel. (Gen. 35-27) Phares and Zara, Juda's Twins! (Gen. 46) Jacob died at 147 yrs. Joseph at 110. EXODUS 600,000 men besides children left in "Exodus" from Egypt after a sojourn of 430 years. (Exod XII - 37) And the children of Israel came in Elim where there were 12 foun- tains of water and 70 palm trees XV - 27 "And if thou make an altar to me, thou shalt not build it of hewn stones, for if thou lift up a tool upon it, it shall be defiled" XX-25 He that striketh a man with a will to kill him, shall be put to death. XXI-12
